description:
Update an existing version of a MantisBT project. Only the fields you pass are changed. Returns the updated version object.

Renaming a version also rewrites the version, target_version and fixed_in_version fields of all issues that reference it (including subprojects if versions are inherited).

Setting released=true does not change the version date — pass timestamp as well (e.g. the release date).

To release a version: released=true, timestamp=<release date>, and optionally next_version=<name> to create the follow-up version in the same call. With next_version the response is { version: <updated>, next_version: <created> } — or next_version_error: <message> if creating the follow-up failed (the update itself stays in effect). Without next_version the response is the updated version object.

The version must belong to project_id itself: versions inherited from a parent project can only be changed via the parent's project_id (otherwise MantisBT answers "Version not found"). get_project with include: ["versions"] and without inherit lists the project's own versions.

Requires the manage_project_threshold access level in the project (MantisBT default: manager).

name.description: New version name (must be unique within the project)

next_version.description: Only with released=true: name of a follow-up version to create as unreleased placeholder, e.g. "1.2.1". Used as-is — no automatic numbering.

project_id.description: Numeric ID of the project the version belongs to — use list_projects to discover project IDs

timestamp.description: Version date as ISO 8601 string, e.g. "2026-09-27" or "2026-09-27T10:00:00+02:00". Determines the order in roadmap and changelog.

version_id.description: Numeric version ID — use get_project with include: ["versions"] to discover version IDs

name: update_version
title: Update Version
